review.notes:
OneShetland is a community platform for Shetland (a Scottish island group): local businesses, deliveries, events, jobs and community groups in one app. Sign in with the reviewer account above — no extra setup needed.

What to expect: it's a real, live community, so most content reflects real local businesses and real events, not filler. A couple of clearly-labelled 'ZZ TEST' items may still be visible; ignore them, they're internal fixtures, not live listings.

Payments: the app takes real payments via Stripe for real-world goods and services only — event tickets, marketplace purchases, delivery fees, local business bookings, and community-group membership dues (the digital equivalent of paying a club subscription in person). Nothing purchasable in this app is digital content or an app-exclusive perk; there is no in-app purchase flow because none of what's sold needs one. The reviewer account has no saved card, so nothing will actually charge unless a card is deliberately added — no payment attempt is required to review any screen.

Account deletion: Account (bottom tab) → Delete account. Two confirmation steps, then it's immediate and permanent — the reviewer account can be recreated afterwards if needed.

Location: used only to match nearby delivery drivers and to confirm you're at a business when tapping a physical NFC point-of-interest tile — both optional, both explained in-app before the permission prompt.

Community content: users can report content and block other users from Account → Blocked users, or from any post/comment's own menu.

en-GB.title: OneShetland
en-GB.subtitle: Local life for Shetland
en-GB.promoText: Community-run and built in Shetland: find local businesses, book a delivery, grab event tickets, and join the groups that make the isles tick.
en-GB.description:
OneShetland brings the everyday life of Shetland — the local businesses, the deliveries, the events, the community groups — into one place.

LOCAL
Browse and support real Shetland businesses: shops, trades, services and more, with the details you actually need — opening hours, contact, what they offer — and a straightforward way to book where that's on offer.

FETCH
Request a local collection or delivery and get matched with a nearby driver. Built for how Shetland actually works: island-to-island, town-to-township, not a city courier model bolted on.

EVENTS
Find out what's on and get your ticket in the app — a QR code at the door, no printing, no faff.

JOBS & SHIFTS
Local jobs and one-off shifts, posted by Shetland employers, applied for from your phone.

COMMUNITY HUBS
Clubs, associations and community groups can run their membership, share updates and take dues through the app — the paperwork a committee used to chase down, handled properly.

WALLET
One balance, topped up once, spent across deliveries, tickets, bookings and more — no re-entering a card every time.

And a few things because Shetland is Shetland: a living Shetland dialect dictionary (Spik), and a bit of daily fun besides.

OneShetland is built and run in Shetland, for Shetland.
